state_note.family: Classified: this edge was assigned a relation family, checked by the calibrated gate.
state_note.pending: Pending review: the two model arms disagreed, so a human ruling is queued. Not yet judged.
state_note.unclassified: No family: a well-formed relation that the vocabulary does not cover. Counted, not hidden.
state_note.not-a-relation: Not a relation: the relation slot holds a clause. Excluded from every family denominator.
state_note.absent: The family layer has not merged into this build. No edge carries a family yet.

boundary_rules.title: Identity vs correspondence on indistinguishability/equivalence
boundary_rules.html: Identity vs correspondence on indistinguishability/equivalence: indistinguishability or equivalence asserted of the terms THEMSELVES → archetypal-identity; asserted of their symbols, images, functions or roles → correspondence. So both CW 9ii §60 edges (mandala indistinguishable-from god-image, wholeness is-psychic-analogue-of god-image — one shared quote: the symbols can no longer be distinguished) are correspondence. The test is what the text predicates indistinguishability OF, not what the nodes are: sentence subject "the symbols of X" → correspondence; sentence subject X itself → identity, even when X is a Symbol-typed node (worked contrast: mercurius is-identical-with saturn, two image-terms, identity). Worked contrast, one relation across two paragraphs (v0.6, ruling of 2026-08-10): mandala is god-image at CW 9i §572 is archetypal-identity, because §572 predicates God-image-hood of the mandala itself; the CW 9ii §60 edges stay correspondence, because §60 predicates indistinguishability of the symbols of the two terms. Same two nodes, same copula, different family — and the difference is the sentence subject, not the node types. The distinguishing note is recorded on the §572 edge in seed.json, so the ruling travels with the data as well as with this document. Placements: is-psychic-analogue-of, coincides-with, comes-closest-to, is-symbolical-equivalent-of, felt-as-equivalent-of → correspondence; is-essentially-same-as, revealed-identity-with, made-equal-to, amounts-to, flat is-equivalent-* of the terms → identity; identical-or-connected-with (12 §476, Jung's own hedge) → unclassified(text-undecided).

boundary_rules.title: Composition vs structural-position
boundary_rules.html: Composition vs structural-position: if the claim entails the subject is materially a constituent of the object → composition; if it locates the subject within the object's structure without asserting constituency → position. Nucleus, centre, foundation default to POSITION (is-nucleus-of, is-centre-of, is-foundation-of, chief-constituent-of reads literally → composition). Totality/unity claims where the subject IS the whole (the-self is-totality-of psyche, 12 §44) → composition, whole-side; unifies-…-into as an act → union.

boundary_rules.title: Psychic-effect vs dependence
boundary_rules.html: Psychic-effect vs dependence: a standing condition ("unless X, no Y"; "must always be dealt with first") → dependence, even when phrased as a blocking act — personal-unconscious bars-gateway-to collective-unconscious {condition: unless dealt with first} (12 §81) is DEPENDENCE. A dynamic act with an outcome → psychic-effect.

boundary_rules.title: Psychic-effect vs opposition on compensation
boundary_rules.html: Psychic-effect vs opposition on compensation: A acts on B to balance it → psychic-effect (the-unconscious compensates consciousness, 14 §184); a standing counter-position → opposition (mercurius compensates christ, 13 §295 — the note says compensatory COUNTERPOINT, not act → opposition).

boundary_rules.title: Sequence vs dependence on precedes
boundary_rules.html: Sequence vs dependence on precedes: "without X, no Y" → dependence (the-shadow precedes anima/animus, 9ii §42, whose quote says recognition is impossible without it); bare order → sequence.

boundary_rules.title: is-a on a named-figure pair is identity, not classification
boundary_rules.html: is-a on a named-figure pair is identity, not classification (v0.4, from the gate). christ is-a anthropos was assigned classification by Opus and flagged WRONG by the gate, with Gemini and the human both saying identity; the quote ("The second Adam is Christ") asserts identity between two named figures, not membership of a class. Rule: when both endpoints are named Figures and the quote asserts they ARE one another, is-a is archetypal-identity. Classification requires the object to be a genuine kind or class.

boundary_rules.title: Doctrinal-attribution outranks the relation's surface verb
boundary_rules.html: Doctrinal-attribution outranks the relation's surface verb (v0.4). Where the quote frames the claim as an act of interpretation by a named tradition or author, attribution wins even when the relation string looks like another family: Gemini read phoenix symbolizes christ as attribution because the paragraph describes the reading being made ("in Christian interpretation"), against Opus's symbolization. Test: is the CLAIM the symbolizing, or someone's act of so reading it?

boundary_rules.title: renewed-through / transformed-through are per edge
boundary_rules.html: renewed-through / transformed-through are per edge (v0.4). Opus read rex renewed-through the-unconscious as dependence, Gemini as psychic-effect, and instrumentality now also claims it. Decide by what the quote asserts: the standing requirement (dependence), the acting-upon (psychic-effect), or the route travelled (instrumentality).

boundary_rules.title: The layer: amplification tag never overrides the content family
boundary_rules.html: The layer: amplification tag never overrides the content family (v0.6; replaces the rule the arms were reading at v0.5). The layer tag is a hand-built annotation on the MATERIAL — it marks an edge as belonging to the amplificatory apparatus of the text. It is not a family assignment and it does not outrank the relation. Classify the edge by what the relation asserts, the same way as any untagged edge; a tagged edge lands in amplification only when the amplification definition itself fits it. Three rulings of 2026-08-10 decided this against three model-arm answers that had cited the tag as decisive, with one precedent application after; the tag currently sits on 57 edges that are spread across six families.

boundary_rules.title: KNOWN AMBIGUITY, awaiting a ruling: underlies versus based-on
boundary_rules.html: KNOWN AMBIGUITY, awaiting a ruling: underlies versus based-on (recorded v0.6; NOT resolved here). Two rules in this document reach opposite families for what may be one sense of "rests on". The composition/position rule routes foundation language to structural-position — is-foundation-of is named there, and all seven live underlies edges follow it. Derivation's string list, meanwhile, carries based-on and develops-on-basis-of. The window-9 Opus arm hit the collision head-on and reported it rather than choosing. Until a ruling: an edge caught between the two rules queues for adjudication; neither rule is amended, and neither is the tiebreak.

boundary_rules.title: Per-edge caveats on promiscuous strings
boundary_rules.html: Per-edge caveats on promiscuous strings: is-a (identity-flavoured at 9ii §42, taxonomic at 9ii §33), embodies ("consists of/composed of" quotes → composition: adam embodies quaternity 14 §555; fusion/reunion quotes → union: filius-regius embodies union-of-opposites 14 §441; guise-of-content edges → manifestation: christ embodies anthropos 9ii §69; enacting-figure edges → personification; edges matching no cue → unclassified(no-family): chariot embodies quaternity 14 §272), symbolizes (9 of 90 sit in the amplification layer), precedes (above). These four are the standing proof that assignment is edge-level.

families.name: symbolization
families.definition_html: The subject is a symbol of the object in Jung's strict sense: "the best possible description or formulation of a relatively unknown fact" (CW 6, Definitions, s.v. Symbol) — not a conventional sign. Directionality test: the OBJECT is the less formulable term; the subject is the image carrying it.
families.boundary_html: not manifestation (there the SUBJECT is the less formulable term showing itself — the direction inverts); not correspondence (two knowns); not personification (a figure enacting).
families.seeds_html: quaternity symbolizes wholeness (9ii §59); fish symbolizes soul (9ii §187); sol is-classical-symbol-for the-self (12 §108, normalized); the-wheel is-symbol-for circulatio (12 §214); christ symbolized-by fish (9ii §147). Strings: symbolizes (90; the amplification-layer edges among them are no longer subtracted — v0.6 classifies them by content like any other), symbolized-by (10), signifies (10), stands-for (6), represents (7).

families.name: personification
families.definition_html: A figure gives personal, enacting form to a content — the subject (usually Figure-typed) is the content wearing a person, acting and speaking.
families.boundary_html: not symbolization (a symbol presents; a personification acts); not identity (anima personifies the-unconscious does not exhaust the unconscious in the anima); not manifestation (the guise there need not be a person).
families.seeds_html: anima personifies the-unconscious (9ii §26); maya personifies projection-making-factor (9ii §20); christ personifies the-unconscious (13 §448, normalized). Strings: personifies (22), is-personified-by, and embodies ONLY on enacting-figure edges (see boundary rules).

families.name: manifestation
families.definition_html: The subject shows itself under the form of the object: one content, one appearing guise, the subject persisting and not exhausted by any guise. Directionality is the definiens: the SUBJECT is the less formulable term.
families.boundary_html: inverts symbolization's direction test; not transformation (the subject persists — Mercurius manifests as lumen naturae, Proteus AND Regina); not generation (nothing new is brought forth); not personification (the guise need not be a person: sol manifests-as archeus).
families.seeds_html: mercurius manifests-as lumen-naturae / proteus / regina; syzygy manifests-as christ-and-church (9ii §41); the-devil manifests-as antichrist; archetype manifests-through synchronicity (9ii §148); aqua-permanens is-aspect-of mercurius (13 §370, inverse direction). Strings: manifests-as (8), manifests, manifests-through, is-made-manifest-in, is-figured-as, worshipped-as, is-often-represented-as, is-presented-through; inverse: is-aspect-of, aspect-of, is-dark-aspect-of. NOT here: appears-as-centre-of → structural-position (a place claim, per the composition/position rule); appears-as-archetype-of (2) → classification with a per-edge caveat (the object is what the subject is archetype OF, not a guise).

notes.label: Inverse pair declared
notes.html: manifests-as / is-aspect-of (with is-manifestation-of) — the aspect strings run the SAME relation in the inverse direction (the subject is the partial showing, the object the content shown: lilith is-aspect-of adam), and the inverse declaration handles them without breaking the direction test. antichrist manifests enantiodromia is likewise inverse-direction and classified here.

families.name: archetypal-identity
families.definition_html: The text asserts the two terms are ONE — via the projection thesis: a single archetype behind both terms (Edinger, Anatomy of the Psyche; the answer to the literal-absurdity objection). Includes scoped identity where a qualifier restricts the claim. Symmetric in principle; synonym-of carries the owl:SymmetricProperty precedent.
families.boundary_html: the strongest family — demand the text's own identity assertion of the TERMS (see the indistinguishability rule above). Watch identity overreach, the E-series' recurring catch.
families.seeds_html: mercurius is-identical-with saturn (13 §274, scoped: as senex); synonym-of (22); identified-with (14), is-identified-with (13); the-devil is-equivalent-to mercurius {scope: dark half} (14 §238); is-essentially-same-as (13 §111).

families.name: correspondence
families.definition_html: Two terms answer each other across registers or traditions — structural likeness asserted without identity. The workhorse of the comparative method.
families.boundary_html: weaker than identity (see the equivalence placements), stronger than amplification (which is an adduced widening, not an asserted relation between the terms).
families.seeds_html: animus corresponds-to logos / anima corresponds-to eros (9ii §29); leviathan corresponds-to the-devil (9ii §178); anthropos coincides-with the-self (13 §268); mandala indistinguishable-from god-image (9ii §60, per the boundary rule); wholeness is-psychic-analogue-of god-image (9ii §60); wholeness cannot-be-distinguished-from god-image (9ii §73, per the indistinguishability rule). Strings: corresponds-to (58), is-analogue-of (13), parallels (10), is-parallel-to, agrees-with, is-psychic-analogue-of (6), comes-closest-to, are-likened-to, coincides-with (5).

families.name: amplification
families.definition_html: A parallel adduced to widen the interpretive basis of an image — "the use of mythic, historical and cultural parallels … metaphorical, never literal" (Samuels, Shorter & Plaut, A Critical Dictionary of Jungian Analysis, pp. 16–17) — BY WHOEVER adduces it (agent-neutral per rule 3; 28 of the 43 amplified-by edges carry reported or quoted voice, so an agent-bound definition would contradict the data and pre-decide E11).
families.boundary_html: correspondence asserts a relation between the terms; amplification adduces material to read an image by. The layer: amplification field is a hand-built annotation on the material, NOT a family assignment and never a tiebreak — see the layer-tag boundary rule above, which the 2026-08-10 sitting installed in place of the reading it retired. It tags 41 of the 43 amplified-by edges (lapis amplified-by shulamite 14 §185 and prima-materia amplified-by isis 14 §16 lack the tag — a layer repair item) plus 9 symbolizes, 2 symbolized-by, 2 parallels, and 3 singletons: 57 edges over seven strings, which is why one string splits across families — and why the tag itself splits across families too.
families.seeds_html: coniunctio amplified-by rex, and the amplified-by edges generally, where the relation states the adducing. A layer-tagged symbolizes edge is NOT a seed here: those are classified by what they assert, and the three ruled on in 2026-08-10 came out symbolization, archetypal-identity and classification.

families.name: classification
families.definition_html: Plain taxonomy: the subject is an instance or kind of the object.
families.boundary_html: not identity (a member is not its class); not manifestation (an aspect is not a kind — the aspect strings moved out at v0.2); is-a is polysemous per the boundary rules.
families.seeds_html: animus is-a psychopomp (9ii §33); the-self is-a archetype (9ii §257). On the-self is-a god-image (9ii §42): the quote is disjunctive ("is a God-image, or at least cannot be distinguished from one") → unclassified(text-undecided) unless the annotator judges the scope qualifier settles it as identity.

families.name: composition
families.definition_html: Part–whole: the subject contains, includes, or is a constituent of the object (either direction; the verb settles which). Includes whole-side totality claims (the-self is-totality-of psyche, 12 §44).
families.boundary_html: the composition/position rule above (nucleus/centre/foundation default to position); union is an act of joining, composition a standing parthood.
families.seeds_html: the-self includes the-shadow (9ii §76); contains (9); includes (6); wise-old-man completes marriage-quaternio (9ii §42); adam embodies quaternity (14 §555, per the embodies caveat).

notes.label: Concealment placement
notes.html: containment-as-concealment (lies-hidden-in, concealed-within, imprisoned-in, harbours) → composition when the claim is in-ness, position when the claim is where; epistemic concealment acts (unlocks-secret-of, obstructs-discovery-of, covers-up) → unclassified(no-family) — recorded as a candidate future family.

families.name: structural-position
families.definition_html: The subject's place within a structure: centre, periphery, seat, abode, between-position, schema-role, ordinal place. The family the Aion evidence demanded (b-cw9ii-1 minted is-centre-of, is-schema-for; batches 3–4 added is-abode-of, is-seat-of, is-first-fish-of, is-second-fish-of, dwells-in) — admitted under the seam rule as an ADDITION; no existing family was redefined.
families.boundary_html: the composition/position rule above.
families.seeds_html: christ is-centre-of christian-mandala (9ii §69); marriage-quaternio is-schema-for the-self (9ii §42); the-north is-abode-of the-devil (9ii §157); mercurius dwells-in celestial-pole (9ii §206); the-self lies-at-border-of the-unconscious {carrier: consciousness} (13 §67); the-devil is-fourth-person-beside the-trinity (12 §192); the-ego centre-of consciousness (9ii §11).

families.name: union
families.definition_html: The terms are joined, married, fused — the coniunctio class, central enough in this corpus to stand apart from composition.
families.boundary_html: an act or achieved state of joining distinct terms, vs composition's standing parthood; three-place unions ("A unites B[-and-C]") keep the united pair in object or qualifiers.
families.seeds_html: mercurius unites the-opposites (12 §404); lapis unites the-opposites (12 §140, 13 §131); spirit unites the-opposites (9ii §141); yesod unites tifereth-malchuth (14 §635); the-self unites-with anima (14 §736); conjoined-with; flows-together-in (13 §218).

families.name: separation
families.added: added at v0.2 — review finding 11; reworked at v0.3
families.definition_html: The separatio/solutio class, in BOTH its structures: (i) A is parted, extracted or freed from B; (ii) A dissolves, separates or splits B. The opus's counter-operation to union and as central.
families.boundary_html: not transformation (where the subject BECOMES the object — so messiah splits-into the-opposites, whose quote says the split "becomes a complete polarity", is transformation-toward-opposition and goes per edge, not here); not psychic-effect (separation asserts the parting itself, not a dynamic residue — this is a definitional distinction, not just check-order).
families.seeds_html: lapis is-extracted-from man (9ii §256); solutio dissolves the-body (14 §316); luna dissolves rex (14 §506); consciousness separates the-opposites (12 §30); unio-mentalis achieved-by-separating the-body (14 §671). Strings: dissolves, is-extracted-from, separates, is-separated-from, frees-god-from, delivered-from, splits-into (per edge), abolish-separation-from (negated — read per edge; may be union).

families.name: transformation
families.definition_html: The subject turns into, or is turned into, the object.
families.boundary_html: not generation (the parent persists beside the offspring); not sequence (order without becoming); not manifestation (a guise is not a becoming — the subject persists unchanged behind it).
families.seeds_html: transforms-into (6); anima was-transformed-into lilith (13 §399); mandala transforms chaos (9ii §60); hierosgamos developed-into coniunctio (9ii §72); renewed-as, reborn-as.

families.name: generation
families.definition_html: The subject brings forth or begets the object — psychological or mythological parenthood, the parent persisting beside the offspring.
families.boundary_html: not transformation; not derivation (historical/doctrinal descent is family 14, split out at v0.2 — the same verb "originates" serves both, so read the terms: traditions derive, beings beget); kinship ROLES (brother, consort) are family 20.
families.seeds_html: produces (8); begets (3); four-elements give-rise-to will (9ii §100); fish is-son-of great-mother (9ii §173); brings-forth.

notes.label: Inverse pair declared
notes.html: produces / originates-in (alongside produces/produced-by) — projection originates-in the-unconscious (9ii §17) and god-image originates-in psychoid (14 §787) are generation, inverse direction; only tradition-to-tradition originates-in (per §14's relation test) is derivation.

families.name: derivation
families.definition_html: Doctrinal, historical or textual transmission: one tradition, doctrine, text or figure draws from, descends from, influences or supplants another.
families.boundary_html: generation begets beings; derivation transmits ideas and forms. The RELATION itself must assert transmission (draws from, descends from, influences, supplants, continues). Subject type is evidence, never a default — a tradition-subject edge whose relation asserts telos, privation, expression or opposition takes THAT family (alchemy reached-its-summit-in faust → telos; privatio-boni makes-evil-diminution-of good → privation; dogma expresses collective-unconscious → symbolization).

seeds.text: yahweh influenced jakob-boehme {scope: through the Cabala}

families.seeds_html: alchemy originates-in gnosticism (9ii §267); yahweh influenced jakob-boehme {scope: through the Cabala} (9ii §111); paracelsus draws-knowledge-from lumen-naturae (13 §148); lapis-christ-parallel was-bridge-into alchemy (13 §387); the-opus replaces-sacraments-of christianity (13 §232). Strings: derives-…-from, has-roots-in, rooted-in, springs-from, proceeded-from, has-a-source-in, probably-chief-source-of, forerunner-of, has-precursor-in, continues-doctrine-of, takes-the-place-of, based-on, develops-on-basis-of, shares-allegories-with.

families.name: sequence
families.definition_html: Temporal or processual order without becoming, begetting or requirement.
families.boundary_html: transformation/generation entail order — assign the stronger family when the text supports it; "without X, no Y" is dependence (see boundary rules). NO transitivity (uroboros argument).
families.seeds_html: the-opus begins-with nigredo (9ii §231); is-first-stage-of (9ii §42); rubedo immediately-preceded-completion-of the-opus (12 §269); followed-by. (precedes distributes per edge — see boundary rules; the sixth precedes edge, albedo→rubedo, is the empty-references defect.)

families.name: prefiguration
families.definition_html: Typological anticipation: the subject foreshadows the object as type to antitype — the pattern exists earlier and points forward.
families.boundary_html: not sequence (order without pointing); not correspondence (alignment without the temporal arrow). "Anticipation" language is the cue.

seeds.text: jupiter heralds messiah {carrier: Saturn, condition: in Pisces}

families.seeds_html: prefigures (8); son-of-man is-anticipation-of the-self (12 §314); jupiter heralds messiah {carrier: Saturn, condition: in Pisces} (9ii §128); foreshadows.

families.name: telos
families.added: added at v0.2 — review finding 12; widened at v0.3
families.definition_html: Goal-direction AND goal-attainment: the subject aims at, strives toward, culminates in, reaches, or attains the object as its end. The teleology of the opus — one of the corpus's main axes.
families.boundary_html: a goal is not the next term (sequence) and not a requirement (dependence). Against psychic-effect: telos claims an end pursued or reached BY the subject on its own arc; psychic-effect claims one term acting on the other. Attainment of one's own end is telos, not effect.
families.seeds_html: self-knowledge aims-at the-self (9ii §252); the-self goal-of individuation (9i §278); lapis is-goal-of the-opus (14 §759); night-sea-journey aims-at rebirth (12 §436 normalized); alchemy reached-its-summit-in faust (12 §558); the-self fulfils-itself-in wholeness (9ii §123). Strings: aims-at, aimed-at, goal-of, is-goal-of, culminates-in (2), attains (2), destined-for, tends-towards, is-movement-toward, fulfils-itself-in, is-consummated-on, reaches.

families.name: opposition
families.definition_html: The terms stand against each other: enmity, polarity, contradiction, standing counter-position (including compensatory counterpoint — see boundary rules).
families.boundary_html: not mere difference or lack — negation without enmity is privation (family 19); the text must set the terms AGAINST each other.
families.seeds_html: antichrist opposes christ (9ii §69); leviathan opposes behemoth (9ii §181); is-equivalent-opposite-of (9ii §84/98); polarizes-with (4); mercurius compensates christ (13 §295, per the compensation rule); came-into-tension-with (13 §290).

families.name: privation
families.definition_html: Lack, absence, negated identity or negated capacity: A lacks B, A is not B, A cannot be/represent B. The privatio-boni axis — Aion's spine — lives here.
families.boundary_html: opposition requires enmity; privation only absence or non-identity. Negated-modal identity ("cannot be distinguished") is NOT here — it follows the indistinguishability rule (identity or correspondence).
families.seeds_html: christ lacks the-shadow (9ii §79); god-image lacks man (9ii §185); the-trinity lacks the-devil (11 §103); putissimus-homo cannot-be christ (13 §390); animus cannot-represent-totality-of the-self (13 §342); privatio-boni makes-evil-diminution-of good (9ii §74); evil does-not-lead-to manichaean-dualism (9ii §99); archetypal-image distinct-from archetype (8 §417); christ is-never-matched-by the-self (9ii §124); the-centre occupies-different-plane-from the-ego (12 §135).

families.name: kinship
families.definition_html: Standing familial or consort roles at the mythologem level: sibling, spouse, bride, companion, double, contrasexual counterpart.
families.boundary_html: generation covers parent/child acts of begetting; kinship covers the standing role. Not union (a consort is a role, not an act of joining).
families.seeds_html: the-devil is-elder-brother-of christ (9ii §77, §103); shulamite consort-of anthropos (14 §609); soul is-the-bride-of christ (9ii §72); behemoth is-double-of leviathan (9ii §185); is-feminine-half-of, masculine-half-of, is-anima-of, companion-of; is-shadow-of per edge (luna is-shadow-of sol 14 §172 = contrasexual counterpart, here; leviathan is-shadow-of yahweh 9ii §183 = the shadow-relation, opposition).

families.name: doctrinal-attribution
families.definition_html: A carrier names, defines, translates, teaches, interprets or classifies — the relation records an act of predication by someone, not an ontology between subject and object.
families.boundary_html: the decisive test — remove the carrier and the claim collapses. Voice often co-varies but never decides (rule 3). Tradition-to-tradition transmission is derivation; a single carrier's predication is attribution.
families.seeds_html: hun is-translated-as animus {carrier: Wilhelm} (13 §57); prima-materia was-designated-as mercurius (12 §517); the-wheel is-in-boehme-a-concept-for wholeness (12 §216); augustine identifies-god-image-with soul (9ii §71); origen locates-imago-dei-in soul (9ii §70); aniadus is-defined-as inner-man {carrier: Ruland} (13 §194); basil-the-great denies-god-authorship-of evil (9ii §82 — an attributed denial: the carrier's act, not a privation between the terms).

families.name: projection
families.definition_html: Psychic contents relocated into an outer carrier — the central explanatory mechanism for alchemy. Includes withdrawal edges.
families.boundary_html: not symbolization (a symbol formulates; a projection relocates and is later withdrawn); not manifestation (the archetype showing itself is not relocated by a psyche).

seeds.text: artifex projected individuation {scope: into the phenomena of chemical change}

families.seeds_html: mercurius is-projection-of the-unconscious (13 §259); lapis is-projection-of the-self (9ii §264); artifex projected individuation {scope: into the phenomena of chemical change} (12 §564); tree-nymph is-a-projection-of anima (13 §458); consciousness develops-through-withdrawal-of projection (13 §122).

families.name: dependence
families.definition_html: Requirement, precondition, subordination, rulership: one term needs, presupposes or is governed by the other — a STANDING condition.
families.boundary_html: the dependence rules above absorb conditional "precedes" and blocking-phrased requirements (bars-gateway-to).
families.seeds_html: coniunctio is-prerequisite-for wholeness (9ii §58); the-ego subordinate-to the-self (9ii §9); aeon-of-the-fishes is-ruled-by hostile-brothers (9ii §142); wholeness requires anima (12 §295); the-shadow precedes anima (9ii §42, per the precedes rule); are-necessary-conditions-of (9ii §112); personal-unconscious bars-gateway-to collective-unconscious (12 §81).

families.name: psychic-effect
families.definition_html: One term acts dynamically on the other: overpowers, activates, stimulates, suppresses, heals, endangers, produces a state in. Deliberately the LAST family checked — if any more specific family fits, take it. Exists so genuine dynamics do not leak into unclassified; the tail test watches whether it becomes a dumping ground.
families.boundary_html: all the rules above drain this family first (dependence, opposition-as-counterpoint, separation, telos).
families.seeds_html: consciousness is-overpowered-by the-unconscious (12 §438); the-unconscious compensates consciousness (14 §184); soul produces-negative-inflation-in the-unconscious (9ii §114); projection leads-to-psychoses-of mass-psyche (13 §52); artifex activates the-unconscious (13 §220); mediates (4); undergoes (5); consciousness leads-to-crucifixion-of the-ego (9ii §79).

families.name: instrumentality
families.added: added at v0.4 — earned by measured refusal
families.definition_html: The object is the MEANS by which the subject is reached, enabled, effected or made possible. Not what happens, but what it happens through.
families.boundary_html: telos names the END pursued; instrumentality names the route to it (homo-maximus is-approached-through the-opus — the opus is the road, the homo maximus the destination). Not dependence: a precondition must be satisfied before, a means is used to. Not psychic-effect: the subject is not acted upon by the object, it travels by it.
families.seeds_html: homo-maximus is-approached-through the-opus (13 §203); temenos enables-meeting-with the-unconscious (12 §63); imaginatio unlocks-secret-of the-opus (12 §400); mandala is-built-up-through active-imagination (12 §123); rex renewed-through the-unconscious; unio-mentalis achieved-by-separating the-body (14 §671, per edge — the separation reading may win where the parting itself is the claim). ## What is deliberately NOT here - No transitivity on any family; symmetry and inverses only as declared (see the precedents table). - No family for "is" as such — the copula distributes by context; the canonical argument for edge-level assignment. - No voice-derived families (rule 3). - No manifestation/appearance merger into symbolization — the direction test separates them and 19 edges depend on it.

notes.label: Evidence for the addition
notes.html: both model arms of the step-0 test refused items this family now covers, independently and with converging reasons — Gemini on homo-maximus is-approached-through the-opus ("an instrument/means relation is not covered by the existing families") and both arms on temenos enables-meeting-with the-unconscious ("an instrumental/affordance relation does not fit structural-position, dependence, or psychic-effect"). 13 strings and 13 edges in the live vocabulary carry the sense.
